back: A statement of the cash received and paid in a year, grouped into operating, investing and financing activities.
Operating: trading, interest and tax. Investing: non-current assets. Financing: shares, loans, dividends.
Lists cash received from customers and cash paid to suppliers, employees, interest and tax.
Starts from profit before tax; adds back depreciation and finance costs; adjusts for changes in inventories, receivables and payables; then deducts interest and tax paid.
Opening cash + net cash from operating, investing and financing activities.
Increase in inventories or receivables: deduct. Increase in payables: add. Decreases: the opposite.
It was deducted in arriving at profit but no cash was paid.
Timing of credit sales, capital purchases, loan repayments and dividends all separate profit from cash.

front: Statement of cash flows and cash flow forecast
back: The statement looks back at the year; the forecast looks ahead.
